entries.title: Psalms 64:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 64:2
segments: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

entries.title: Psalms 64:3
segments: Who whet their tongue like a sword, [and] bend [their bows to shoot] their arrows, [even] bitter words:

entries.title: Psalms 64:4
segments: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
segments: They encourage themselves [in] an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them? {matter: or, speech} {of...: Heb. to hide his snares}

words.text: them? {matter: or, speech} {of...: Heb. to hide his snares}

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward [thought] of every one [of them], and the heart, [is] deep. {they...: or, we are consumed by that which they have throughly searched} {a diligent...: Heb. a search searched}

words.text: . {they...: or, we are consumed by that which they have throughly searched} {a diligent...: Heb. a search searched}

entries.title: Psalms 64:7
segments: ¶But God shall shoot at them [with] an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded. {shall they...: Heb. their wound shall be}

words.text: . {shall they...: Heb. their wound shall be}

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
segments: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

words.text: So they shall make their own tongue

entries.title: Psalms 64:9
segments: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

entries.title: Psalms 64:10
segments: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

words.text: in him; and all the upright
